channel.title: The Black Hourglass
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Black Hourglass" - A black hourglass that consumes time itself and a man trying to overcome the guilt he feels for surviving.

Thanks for the feedback and suggestions!

+ show block

My first main concern is that you didn't cite your image.

The photo is actually something I took and uploaded myself. Would I still need to cite the image or is it fine since it's mine?

The focus of your is on Licht's character arc, but your logs are pretty detached from that. You can also cut down on the description of SCP-####-A through -I by having there only be one button that lets Licht move outside of the flow of time, and then just letting him walk around outside of time instead of using multiple other buttons to do so.

I did want to have some test logs to give the story a bit more time to sink in and develop, as well as flesh out the abilities of the SCP in the reader's minds. However, I do agree that these can be distracting. I attempted to keep them out of the way in collapsibles, but if they are really an issue I can remove them.

I'd put a footnote briefly defining "gravitational lensing", since I imagine most readers won't know what that is.

I didn't really think of that. Nice catch. I'll be sure to add it in the footnotes.

with genetic matches to theirs were discovered at [DATA EXPUNGED]

I don't understand why this is redacted. I'd recommend reading this guide

In my mind, this was redacted to conceal information about the way in which the foundation disposes of staff that die by anomalous means. If it ends up a big issue, I'm open to removing it and writing something in its place.

item.title: Re: The Black Hourglass
item.content:encoded:
+Overall Thoughts
– hide block

Overall, I thought it was alright. You were worried about your dialogue, but it seemed fine to me (however, I'm not the best with dialogue, so you should definitely get a second opinion).

My first main concern is that you didn't cite your image. First, check the image use guidelines and make sure that your image is CC compliant. If it is, put a license box at the bottom of the page. If it isn't, you can't use it in your article. If you want to know where to find CC compliant images, I would recommend Wikimedia Commons and CCSearch.

My second issue are the test logs. The focus of your is on Licht's character arc, but your logs are pretty detached from that. You can also cut down on the description of SCP-####-A through -I by having there only be one button that lets Licht move outside of the flow of time, and then just letting him walk around outside of time instead of using multiple other buttons to do so.

+line-by-line
– hide block

SCP-#### has the ability to create a temporal anomaly capable of consuming the time of macroscopic life

"consuming time" is pretty vague. You explain the effect of this later in the paragraph, but I think you should find a better descriptor for the SCP's effect.

The activation time is inconsistent, along with the amount of time SCP-#### consumes.

I'd change this to "Both the activation time and the amount of time SCP-#### consumes1 are inconsistent."

SCP-#### appears to be designed to permanently attach itself to an humanoid individual. The requirements for this process to occur are as of yet unknown. It is also unknown if it is possible to remove SCP-#### without physically damaging the individual which it has attached to.

This makes it sound like SCP-#### is physically attached to an individual, when the recovery log shows that it just floats near them.

extreme gravitational lensing

I'd put a footnote briefly defining "gravitational lensing", since I imagine most readers won't know what that is (or maybe everyone knows what that is and it's just me).

it has been designated SCP-####-2

I'd change it to SCP-####-1 since you never mentioned -1.

with genetic matches to theirs were discovered at [DATA EXPUNGED]

I don't understand why this is redacted. I'd recommend reading this guide

I just happen to be in the wrong place

You don't need to change this since dialogue doesn't have to have perfect grammar, but "happen" should be "happened"

Subject entered within 10 meters of SCP-####. Immediately, SCP-#### began activating, and subject disappeared from the cell.

I'd change this to "SCP-#### activated immediately after subject entered within 10 meters of SCP-####." You can remove "subject disappeared from the cell" because the next couple sentences imply that the subject disappeared.

Subject 6 was found to have transported to a closed doorway, and suffered [DATA EXPUNGED]. Subject died █ minutes after initial recovery.

I'd change this to "Subject 6 was found to have been transported inside of a closed doorway and could not be recovered." Saying that they couldn't be recovered implies that they were located but died before they could be properly rescued.

item.title: The Black Hourglass - SCP
item.content:encoded:
Hi there. This is my first SCP draft so here is the link to my greenlights: Idea Thread

I've made some major changes per the suggestions made in that thread and would like your feedback. Some things I'm looking for critique on include: clinical tone, line by line, general formatting, and emotional impact, although critique of any kind is appreciated. I also think that dialogue is one of my weaker points as a writer, so I'm definitely looking for opinions on that.

Here's the link to my sandbox: http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/dr-hajovsky
